subject: [PATCH v5 12/19] selftests/mm: parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mixed-source collapse case in the selftests/mm suite to parameterize the source order by adding a new option -s, which specifies the source order alongside the target order -c. The test faults at the specified source order and collapses contpte-mapped sources into larger mTHP if possible. This change allows for more flexible testing of memory huge page (mHP) behavior on different architectures.
